# Workspace instructions

- This is a Phase 1 React/Express/Prisma TypeScript monorepo.
- Preserve the apps/frontend and apps/backend separation.
- Do not add external authentication providers or board features in this phase.
- Keep database operations in Prisma services; keep credentials in environment files.
- Run npm workspaces from the repository root.
- Do not implement board, list, card, drag-and-drop, or AI functionality before its phase.
